scope.timer: summary.trace_ms for complete measured native.trace (336 events)
scope.included: serialized logical request ACKs, input vector uploads, query allocations/launch/synchronization, complete host-ready IDs/fields, updates, compaction/rebuild/refit/refresh, final drain
scope.excluded: cold initial setup/build, separate real 19-event warmup, oracle, counters, profiler, file output
scope.estimator: process-paired geometric P0/P1, P1/P2, P0/P2 ratios
scope.acceptance: P1/P2 CI lower > 1 and at least 5/6 process wins; no independent FULL-kNN claim
scope.secondary: ACK p10/median/p90 by operation; process total by range/knn/update; order strata; marginal median ratios
